system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: **SKILL.md**: domain expertise reference injected into context at runtime.
system_prompt_style.note: prompt_builder.rs exists in the file tree but its contents are not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Reads files first to understand context, then makes precise changes.
env_context_strategy.note: workspace_context.rs exists in the file tree and may inject context; its contents are not shown.

context_compaction.note: The README mentions 'compaction' and the file tree lists compactor.rs, but the mechanism is not shown.

tool_count.note: The README claims 53 built-in tools and docs/README.md claims 38. Each agent enables its own subset, so there is no single default count.

edit_primitive.note: Inferred only from the file name. file_write probably provides whole-file rewrite, but this is unverified.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: openfang-runtime Agent loop, 3 LLM drivers, 53 tools, WASM sandbox, MCP, A2A
tool_schema_source.note: Whether the built-in tool schemas are hand-written or generated is not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: openfang-runtime Agent loop, 3 LLM drivers, 53 tools, WASM sandbox, MCP, A2A
protocol_standardization.note: 'other' = the OFP P2P protocol (openfang-wire). OFP is project-specific rather than a published standard, so 'other' is uncertain.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Multi-agent pipelines with branching, fan-out, loops, and triggers
loop_primitives.note: react is inferred from agent_loop.rs. event_driven comes from event_bus.rs and schedule triggers. fixed_pipeline comes from workflows.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Meta-agent that decomposes complex tasks, delegates to specialist agents, and synthesizes results.
multi_agent_topology.note: Each template runs as a single agent. The orchestrator template provides orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: delegates work via `agent_send`, spawns new agents when needed
delegation_mechanism.note: Available only in the orchestrator template. A message-passing variant is possible via agent_send.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Guardrails**: approval gates for sensitive actions (e.g. Browser Hand requires approval before any purchase).

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: openfang-memory SQLite persistence, vector embeddings, canonical sessions, compaction

state_persistence.note: The README says 'Pause without losing state', but no resume code path is shown.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: SHA256-based tool call loop detection with circuit breaker.
termination_condition.note: Other termination conditions are not shown.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Intelligent routing with task complexity scoring, automatic fallback, cost tracking, and per-model pricing.
cost_controls.note: token_budget: templates declare an hourly token quota.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: `env_clear()` + selective variable passthrough. Process tree isolation with cross-platform kill.
execution_isolation.note: Tool code also runs in a WASM sandbox. docker_sandbox.rs exists in the file tree.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Blocks private IPs, cloud metadata endpoints, and DNS rebinding attacks.
network_policy.note: This is SSRF protection plus the per-agent capability network=["*"]. It is closest to allowlist but is really a blocklist.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Agents declare required tools, the kernel enforces it.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every action is cryptographically linked to the previous one.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Detects override attempts, data exfiltration patterns, and shell reference injection in skills.
guardrails.note: output_filters: taint tracking. action_policies: capability gates and approvals.

target_domain.evidence_quote: OpenFang is an **open-source Agent Operating System**.

open_source.evidence_quote: MIT. Use it however you want.
